topics.label: Introduction and learning outcomes for the hallmarks of cancer
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the lecture opening, setting out the learning outcomes and the overarching conceptual framework of cancer hallmarks.

topics.label: Growth signaling pathways and proliferative autonomy in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how oncogenic mutations in major signaling cascades, including Wnt/beta-catenin, receptor tyrosine kinases, and TGF-beta, drive sustained proliferation and growth signal autonomy.

topics.label: Block to terminal differentiation in hematologic and epithelial cancers
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics illustrate how failure to undergo terminal differentiation prevents cells from exiting the cell cycle and drives malignancy in both leukemias and intestinal carcinomas.

topics.label: Mechanisms of resistance to apoptosis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic describes how cancer cells evade programmed cell death through alterations in p53 signaling and the balance of pro- and anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family proteins.

topics.label: Replicative immortality, telomere regulation, and senescence bypass
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the regulation of cellular lifespan by telomeres, the induction of senescence by stress signals, and how cancer cells bypass these barriers by reactivating telomerase.

topics.label: Transition to complex hallmarks and cancer metabolic rewiring
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics introduce the transition to complex cancer hallmarks and detail the mechanisms, global tissue patterns, and oncometabolite drivers of metabolic reprogramming.

topics.label: Induction of angiogenesis in tumor progression
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the angiogenic switch and how expanding tumors stimulate new blood vessel formation to overcome nutrient and oxygen limitations.

topics.label: Mechanisms, monitoring, and genetics of tumor metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics cover the multi-step cascade of metastatic dissemination, including physical and microenvironmental barriers, liquid biopsy tracking, and associated genomic characteristics.

topics.label: Summary and concluding remarks
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the closing framing of the lecture, reviewing the convergence of hallmarks and concluding with final remarks.
